name: Building stronger models for graph data
gist: Papers developing new types of neural networks that learn better from graph-structured data by improving how information flows between connected nodes and capturing long-range relationships.
explain: The core insight is that information in a graph lives in the connections, not just the nodes themselves. A person's interests may be similar to their friends' interests, a molecule's properties depend on how its atoms are bonded, and a webpage's topic relates to the pages it links to. So a model needs a way to collect information from neighbors and use it to make better predictions. Most early work did this by averaging neighbors' features at each layer—but averaging loses detail and doesn't capture the many subtle ways that different types of connections matter differently.

The hard part is doing this efficiently at scale while capturing long-range patterns. If you average neighbors, then average neighbors of neighbors, the signal can get diluted—like a game of telephone where the message gets garbled. Also, sometimes a node's most important influence comes from far away in the network, not from its immediate neighbors. And different edges may mean different things (a 'likes' edge is not a 'disagrees with' edge), but simple averaging treats all edges the same way without capturing these distinctions.

Papers in this subtheme propose new designs: better ways to aggregate neighbor information using attention—learning which neighbors matter most—spectral methods that think about the graph's mathematical structure, transformer-based approaches that let distant nodes talk directly so long-range dependencies aren't lost, and techniques to preserve information flow so distant patterns don't fade away. The goal is a model that captures both what each node is locally and how it fits into the overall shape and structure of the entire network, since this context shapes the node's role.

papers.title: AdS-GNN - a Conformally Equivariant Graph Neural Network
papers.contribution: Demonstrates strong performance and improved generalization on computer vision and statistical physics tasks, extracting conformal properties like scaling dimensions.

papers.title: Can Computational Reducibility Lead to Transferable Models for Graph Combinatorial Optimization?
papers.contribution: Multi-task learning with leave-one-out pretraining leads to faster convergence on target tasks while avoiding negative transfer, taking an important step toward foundational models for neural CO.

papers.title: Expressive Graph Neural Networks via Equivariant Use of Noise
papers.contribution: Reaches theoretical universal expressivity while maintaining linear scalability and achieving performance comparable to expensive high-expressivity models.

papers.title: LRIM: a Physics-Based Benchmark for Provably Evaluating Long-Range Capabilities in Graph Learning
papers.contribution: Experiments show both message-passing architectures and graph transformers perform far from optimal, especially scalable methods, providing model-agnostic evidence that local information is insufficient.

papers.title: Learning Posterior Predictive Distributions for Node Classification from Synthetic Graph Priors
papers.contribution: A single pre-trained NodePFN model achieves universal node classification across arbitrary graphs without graph-specific training, reaching 71.27% average accuracy on 23 benchmarks.

papers.title: Learning from Historical Activations in Graph Neural Networks
papers.contribution: Consistent performance improvements on graph classification benchmarks; particularly strong robustness in deep GNNs by leveraging historical activations.

papers.title: MIMO-LP: A Multi-Input Multi-Output Framework for Subgraph-based Link Prediction
papers.contribution: We achieve 14x-44x speedup over existing subgraph-based methods while maintaining comparable predictive performance.

papers.title: Message Passing on the Edge: Towards Scalable and Expressive GNNs
papers.contribution: Shows EB-1WL is significantly more expressive than 1WL with complete logical characterization; EB-GNN admits near-linear time/memory and outperforms standard MPNNs.

papers.title: Native Adaptive Solution Expansion for Diffusion-based Combinatorial Optimization
papers.contribution: Enables adaptive control over intermediate solution states during inference while maintaining constraint feasibility for combinatorial optimization problems.

papers.title: Rethinking the Gold Standard: Why Discrete Curvature Fails to Fully Capture Over-squashing in GNNs?
papers.contribution: Demonstrates that discrete curvature fails to detect 30-40% of over-squashed edges and proposes solution 133.7× faster than existing algorithms.

papers.title: S$^3$GNN: Efficient Global Mixing and Local Message Passing for Long-Range Graph Learning
papers.contribution: S³GNN achieves up to order-of-magnitude error reduction with up to 50% fewer parameters across diverse domains including long-range benchmarks and mesh-based dynamics.

papers.title: A Scalable Inter-edge Correlation Modeling in CopulaGNN for Link Sign Prediction
papers.contribution: Achieves significantly faster convergence than baselines while maintaining competitive link sign prediction performance on signed graphs.

papers.title: A Unified Framework for Deep Hypergraph Clustering Beyond Homophily
papers.contribution: Outperforms state-of-the-art methods on both homophilic and heterophilic datasets with prominent improvement in heterophilic settings.

papers.title: A Unifying Relational Perspective on Expressive Lottery Tickets
papers.contribution: Derives lower bound on probability random pruning yields expressive subnetworks; shows sparse RGNN expressivity connects to optimization behavior; validates on temporal and molecular benchmarks.

papers.title: AdaSpec: Adaptive Spectrum for Enhanced Node Distinguishability
papers.contribution: AdaSpec improves node distinguishability of spectral GNNs across eighteen benchmark datasets.

papers.title: Adaptive Node Feature Selection for Graph Neural Networks
papers.contribution: Rivals tailored feature selection approaches while returning meaningful importance scores before GNN training completes.

papers.title: Adaptive Recurrent Message Passing for Test Time Computing on Graphs
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms baselines in both inductive and transductive settings without changing model parameters.

papers.title: Are we measuring oversmoothing in graph neural networks correctly?
papers.contribution: Rank-based metrics consistently capture oversmoothing across diverse graph architectures and datasets, with theoretical support clarifying why Dirichlet-like measures may fail.

papers.title: Beyond Simple Graphs: Neural Multi-Objective Routing on Multigraphs
papers.contribution: Demonstrates competitive performance across multiple problems and graph distributions against heuristics and neural baselines.

papers.title: Boundary Embedding Shaping with Adaptive Contrastive Learning for Graph Structural Disentanglement
papers.contribution: Improves GCN performance by 3.3% average in node classification and achieves superior link prediction accuracy.

papers.title: Brain Networks Should Be Learned, Not Constructed
papers.contribution: Unfortunately, the fixed brain network may lose critical information during construction and lead to difficulty in performance improvement, even with deliberately designed graph models

papers.title: Bridging Structure and Semantics: Uncertainty-Modulated Dual-Path Diffusion for Robust Text-Attributed Graph Learning
papers.contribution: UDPD demonstrates effectiveness and superiority over baselines across five public benchmarks by progressively aligning different modality distributions while suppressing inherent noise.

papers.title: CLINIC: Towards High-quality Graph Out-Of-Distribution Detection
papers.contribution: CLINIC achieves superior out-of-distribution detection performance across ten real datasets compared to various baselines.

papers.title: DR-GGAD: Dual Residual Centering for Mitigating Anomaly Non‑Discriminativity in Generalist Graph Anomaly Detection
papers.contribution: Achieves new SOTA with mean AUROC +5.14% over best prior GGAD, with large gains on high-AnD datasets (Facebook +12.59%, ACM +9.96%, Amazon +7.48%).

papers.title: DiP-G: Discrete Prompting for Graph Neural Networks
papers.contribution: Maintains scalability and accuracy while avoiding train-test mismatch through discrete prompting on few-shot datasets.

papers.title: Directional Sheaf Hypergraph Networks: Unifying Learning on Directed and Undirected Hypergraphs
papers.contribution: DSHN achieves relative accuracy gains from 2% up to 20% across 7 datasets against 13 baselines by unifying existing Laplacian matrices in the hypergraph learning literature.

papers.title: Dual-channel Dynamic Graph Neural Networks with Adaptive Adjacency Learning and Multi-scale Representation Fusion
papers.contribution: Demonstrate superior discriminative graph representation learning through comprehensive semantic modeling across high-pass and low-pass filtering views on benchmark datasets.

papers.title: Dynamic Multi-sample Mixup with Gradient Exploration for Open-set Graph Anomaly Detection
papers.contribution: DEMO outperforms baselines on various benchmarks for detecting unseen anomalies different from training anomalies.

papers.title: Efficient Learning on Large Graphs using a Densifying Regularity Lemma
papers.contribution: Achieves competitive performance on node classification and graph tasks with memory and computational complexity linear in nodes rather than edges.

papers.title: Entangled No More: Multi-Domain Decoupling for Robust Dynamic Graph Neural Networks
papers.contribution: Superior robustness on benchmarks with adversarial attacks through principled decoupling of spatiotemporal evolution.

papers.title: EquiCAD: A Geometric Equivariant Neural Network for 3D Shape Classiﬁcation
papers.contribution: Achieves substantial improvements on SolidLetters, Parts, Machining Feature benchmark, and newly constructed Features dataset over prior state-of-the-art.

papers.title: Error-Driven Graph Augmentation for Mesh-Based PDE Surrogates
papers.contribution: Consistently improves accuracy and accuracy–compute trade-offs on industrial CFD and CSD benchmarks; error-guided message passing identifies physically challenging regions.

papers.title: Exchangeability of GNN Representations with Applications to Graph Retrieval
papers.contribution: LSH framework supports diverse relevance measures including subgraph matching and graph edit distance more effectively than baselines.

papers.title: Expressive and Invariant Graph Learning via Canonical Tree Cover Neural Networks
papers.contribution: Strictly more expressive than sequence-based canonicalization; consistently outperforms invariant GNNs and random samplers across graph classification benchmarks.

papers.title: FS-KAN: Permutation Equivariant Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks via Function Sharing
papers.contribution: FS-KAN unifies prior work and achieves superior data efficiency compared to standard parameter-sharing layers while maintaining KAN interpretability.

papers.title: Federated Graph Learning via Structure-Aware Fusion Using a Kalman Framework with Learnable Dynamics
papers.contribution: Fed-Kalter consistently outperforms state-of-the-art FGL methods on 16 graph classification datasets across 4 domains while enabling effective knowledge transfer and local personalization.

papers.title: Fixed Aggregation Features Can Rival GNNs
papers.contribution: MLPs trained on FAFs rival or outperform state-of-the-art GNNs on 12 of 14 benchmarks, challenging assumptions about deep GNN necessity.

papers.title: Forest-Based Graph Learning for Semi-Supervised Node Classification
papers.contribution: Achieves comparable results to state-of-the-art on semi-supervised node classification while remaining efficient with linear-time tree aggregation.

papers.title: Foundations of Equivariant Deep Learning: Unifying Graph and Sheaf Neural Networks
papers.contribution: First universal approximation theorem for sheaf neural networks; OENN framework subsumes and extends graph neural networks while enabling leverage of categorical symmetries including non-invertible symmetries with compositional relations.

papers.title: Full-Graph vs. Mini-Batch Training: Comprehensive Analysis from a Batch Size and Fan-Out Size Perspective
papers.contribution: Provides generalization bounds and practical hyperparameter tuning guidance, revealing full-graph training doesn't always yield better performance than optimized mini-batch settings.

papers.title: Full-Spectrum Graph Neural Networks: Expressive and Scalable
papers.contribution: FSpecGNNs universally approximate node-pair signals while admitting scalable implementations and deliver strong performance on heterophilic benchmarks.

papers.title: GI-GCN: Global Interacted Graph Convolutional Networks via Dominant Sets for Graph Classification
papers.contribution: Effectively captures highly correlated information between nonadjacent nodes emphasizing critical graph-level information while enhancing discriminative power with optimized memory complexity.

papers.title: GNN-as-Judge: Unleashing the Power of LLMs for Graph Few-shot Semi-supervised Learning with GNN Feedback
papers.contribution: Significantly outperforms existing methods under low-resource regimes by combining collaborative pseudo-labeling with weakly-supervised LLM fine-tuning.

papers.title: Gelato: Graph Edit Distance via Autoregressive Neural Combinatorial Optimization
papers.contribution: Gelato achieves state-of-the-art results, generalizes to graphs larger than training data, runs orders of magnitude faster than ML competitors, and remains effective under noisy supervision.

papers.title: Generalist Graph Anomaly Detection via Prototype-Based Distillation
papers.contribution: First unsupervised generalist GAD framework achieving zero-shot anomaly detection on unseen graphs through distillation bias and prototype geometric deviation.

papers.title: Generative Representation Learning on Hyper-relational Knowledge Graphs via Masked Discrete Diffusion
papers.contribution: State-of-the-art on standard HKG link prediction and outperforms LLM baselines in generating novel correct facts from arbitrary masked queries.

papers.title: Glance for Context: Learning When to Leverage LLMs for Node-Aware GNN-LLM Fusion
papers.contribution: GLANCE achieves significant gains on heterophilous nodes (up to +5.8%) while maintaining top overall performance (up to +1.1%), with best performance balance across node subgroups.

papers.title: Graph Alignment for Benchmarking Graph Neural Networks and Learning Positional Encodings
papers.contribution: Demonstrates optimal task difficulty for statistically relevant architecture ranking; shows learned node embeddings function as effective positional encodings for transformers with 98% graph reconstruction accuracy.

papers.title: Graph Neural Dynamics via Learned Energy and Tangential Flows
papers.contribution: Achieves strong performance on diverse node and graph classification benchmarks; energy-based framework helps alleviate oversquashing in GNNs.

papers.title: Graph Neural Networks Are Not Continuous Across Graph Resolutions
papers.contribution: The proposed modification ensures consistent generalization between graph resolutions, addressing a fundamental structural obstruction in information-propagation schemes.

papers.title: Graph Representational Learning: When Does More Expressivity Hurt Generalization?
papers.contribution: Generalization bounds reveal that more expressive GNNs may generalize worse unless increased complexity is balanced by sufficiently large training sets or reduced distance between training and test graphs.

papers.title: Graph homophily booster: Reimagining the role of discrete features in heterophilic graph learning
papers.contribution: First method explicitly transforming graphs to improve homophily, significantly outperforming 23 latest GNNs on heterophilic datasets where even MLPs surpass traditional graph methods.

papers.title: GraphP-FL: Personalized Federated Graph Learning via Dynamic Structure Awareness and Fisher Information Elastic Alignment
papers.contribution: Improves accuracy by up to 8.6% on seven benchmarks including biochemical molecules and social networks.

papers.title: GraphPFN: A Prior-Data Fitted Graph Foundation Model
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art results on diverse real-world graph datasets in both in-context learning and finetuning regimes.

papers.title: H$^3$GNNs: Harmonizing Heterophily and Homophily in GNNs via Self-Supervised Node Encoding
papers.contribution: H³GNNs theoretically achieve linear separability under mild conditions and show superior performance on benchmarks with diverse graph patterns.

papers.title: HSMAD: Heterophily-Driven Spectral and Manifold Learning for Graph Anomaly Detection
papers.contribution: The method achieves state-of-the-art performance with average F1-Macro improvements of 2.66% over best-performing methods.

papers.title: Heterogeneity-Aware Knowledge Sharing for Graph Federated Learning
papers.contribution: FedSSA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods on eleven homophilic and heterophilic graph datasets under both non-overlapping and overlapping partitioning settings.

papers.title: Hierarchical Multi Scale Graph Neural Networks: Scalable Heterophilous Learning with Oversmoothing and Oversquashing Mitigation
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 3% improvement on node classification and 7% on graph classification while maintaining linear scalability.

papers.title: Identifying and Correcting Label Noise for Robust GNNs via Influence Contradiction
papers.contribution: The method demonstrates superior performance over competitive baselines on benchmark datasets in noisy label scenarios.

papers.title: InvGNN: Learning Invertible Node Representations on Graphs
papers.contribution: InvGNNs match the expressive power of the 1-dimensional Weisfeiler-Leman algorithm and perform comparably to established GNNs on classification while enabling density estimation and node feature generation.

papers.title: Is Fixing Schema Graphs Necessary? Full-Resolution Graph Structure Learning for Relational Deep Learning
papers.contribution: Outperforms existing approaches while revealing how table roles impact downstream tasks.

papers.title: L2G-NET: Local to Global Spectral Graph Neural Networks via Cauchy Factorizations
papers.contribution: Scales to large graphs with long-range dependencies, competitive with state-of-the-art methods using orders of magnitude fewer learnable parameters.

papers.title: Latent Geometry-Driven Network Automata for Complex Network Dismantling
papers.contribution: Outperforms all existing dismantling algorithms across 1,475 real-world networks and scales efficiently via GPU acceleration while enabling network robustness engineering.

papers.title: Learning Dynamic Stability Landscapes in Synchronization Networks
papers.contribution: Demonstrates that stability landscapes are learnable from topology and generalize across graph sizes and to realistic power grid topologies, enabling movement beyond scalar stability indices.

papers.title: Low-pass Personalized Subgraph Federated Recommendation
papers.contribution: LPSFed achieves superior recommendation accuracy with improved robustness on five real-world datasets.

papers.title: MC-HNN: Learning Latent Structural Semantics and High-Rank Representations for Hypergraph Neural Networks
papers.contribution: Alleviates rank collapse and semantic dependency bottlenecks, achieving strong empirical performance on hypergraph tasks.

papers.title: Message Tuning Outshines Graph Prompt Tuning: A Prismatic Space Perspective
papers.contribution: Proves Message Tuning adaptation capacity exceeds theoretical upper bound of graph prompt tuning.

papers.title: Modeling Spectral Energy Shifts in Spatio-Temporal Graph Anomaly Detection
papers.contribution: Detects camouflaged anomalies previously undetectable; achieves effectiveness and scalability on large-scale benchmarks with unified architecture for temporal settings.

papers.title: Neural Message-Passing on Attention Graphs for Hallucination Detection
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms leading approaches across diverse benchmarks and exhibits promising zero-shot cross-dataset transfer performance.

papers.title: On The Expressive Power of GNN Derivatives
papers.contribution: Expressive power aligns with WL hierarchy with efficient message-passing algorithm for computing derivatives, showing strong performance on graph learning tasks.

papers.title: On the Spectral Unreachability of Brain Graph Learning
papers.contribution: HiSP-Net consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in brain network classification while extracting stable and structurally coherent functional biomarkers.

papers.title: On the Universality and Complexity of GNN for Solving Second-order Cone Programs
papers.contribution: Provides rigorous foundation linking GNN expressivity and generalization to conic optimization, with numerical experiments on SOCPs and real-world power grid problems.

papers.title: Plain Transformers are Surprisingly Powerful Link Predictors
papers.contribution: PENCIL outperforms heuristic-informed GNNs and ID-embedding alternatives across diverse benchmarks without node features, while remaining competitive and far more parameter-efficient.

papers.title: Rethinking Contrastive Learning for Graph Collaborative Filtering: Limitations and a Simple Remedy
papers.contribution: Proposes NT-SSM with type-aware neighbor pair weight update dynamics, achieving consistent performance improvements over SSM across datasets and GCF models.

papers.title: Rethinking GNNs and Missing Features: Challenges, Evaluation and a Robust Solution
papers.contribution: Shows that simple baselines can match specialized methods across diverse datasets and missingness regimes, challenging prior assumptions about GNN robustness.

papers.title: Rethinking Graph Transformers as Graph Signal Denoisers: The Role of Block-Diagonal Priors
papers.contribution: BDFormer establishes superior performance and scalability by achieving block-diagonal propagation structure with linear-time complexity.

papers.title: Revisiting Pre-Propagation GNNs: Robust Diffusion Operators and Hidden-State Re-Propagation
papers.contribution: Methods improve validation and test accuracy of PP-GNNs, enabling them to match message-passing GNNs while maintaining training efficiency.

papers.title: Same Graph Cross-Task Transfer in GNNs: Protocols and Predictors
papers.contribution: Reveals that NC→LP is consistently beneficial on homophilic graphs while LP→NC is fragile; LP becomes reliable pretraining only in structure-dominant regimes; introduces CoTask Score (CTS) to summarize joint utility.

papers.title: Scalable Topology-Preserving Graph Coarsening: Concepts and Algorithms
papers.contribution: STPGC achieves efficient graph coarsening while rigorously preserving topological features and accelerating GNN training demonstrated on node classification tasks.

papers.title: Smoothness Errors in Dynamics Models and How to Avoid Them
papers.contribution: Outperforms transformers and equivariant networks on PDEs over complex meshes and weather forecasting.

papers.title: TGM: A Modular and Efficient Library for Machine Learning on Temporal Graphs
papers.contribution: Achieves 7.8× speedup over DyGLib and 175× speedup on graph discretization while enabling new research possibilities in dynamic graph property prediction and time-driven training.

papers.title: TetraGT: Tetrahedral Geometry-Driven Explicit Token Interactions with Graph Transformer for Molecular Representation Learning
papers.contribution: Achieves superior performance on PCQM4Mv2 and OC20 IS2RE benchmarks, demonstrating excellent transfer learning results and scalability on downstream molecular property prediction tasks.

papers.title: Towards Quantifying Long-Range Interactions in Graph Machine Learning: a Large Graph Dataset and a Measurement
papers.contribution: Provides benchmark for evaluating long-range interactions and theoretical justifications based on over-smoothing and influence score dilution.

papers.title: Understanding Truncated Positional Encodings for Graph Neural Networks
papers.contribution: Shows truncated spectral PEs are no longer stronger than 1-WL test, with experiments indicating mixed truncated PE families are preferable on real datasets.

papers.title: Unitary Convolutions for Message-passing and Positional Encodings on Directed Graphs
papers.contribution: Avoids exponential oversmoothing; achieves SOTA on 12 directed-graph benchmarks trainable beyond 100 layers with up to 18 percentage point improvements.

papers.title: VDW-GNNs: Vector diffusion wavelets for geometric graph neural networks
papers.contribution: VDW-GNNs demonstrate effectiveness on synthetic point cloud data and real-world wind field and neural activity measurements, with proven frame-theoretic properties and rotation-translation symmetries.

papers.title: View Space: Learning Representation across Arbitrary Graphs
papers.contribution: Recurrent GVT pretrained on OGBN-Arxiv outperforms GraphAny by +8.93% and surpasses 12 individually tuned GNNs by >3.30% on 27 benchmarks.

papers.title: WATS: Wavelet-Aware Temperature Scaling for Reliable Graph Neural Networks
papers.contribution: Achieves lowest ECE across benchmarks, outperforming baselines by up to 41.2% while remaining computationally efficient across diverse graph sizes.

papers.title: What Makes a Desired Graph for Relational Deep Learning?
papers.contribution: Optimized graphs improve accuracy on 23 tasks spanning classification, regression, recommendation while often reducing inference cost.

papers.title: gLSTM: Mitigating Over-Squashing by Increasing Storage Capacity
papers.contribution: Demonstrates strong performance on capacity synthetic tasks and real-world graph benchmarks by increasing node representation storage capacity.
